Author: Stwohm (fork of yagi2/Restocker)
Name: Restocky
Changelog: 0.3.14.4 — Fix: a late AllaganMarket sale notice (more than 10 minutes after the sale) could record the same sale a second time on an older or relisted stack. 0.3.14.3 — A restocked listing priced above skipped bait now shows the bait notice with [Match bait] in chat and in the Reprice tab. 0.3.14.2 — Trial items are auto-restocked like the others; set Restock to Alert on an item to keep it out. Fix: auto-restock could skip a sold-out item with an empty board (sale proceeds were off by 1 gil, so the last sale price was rejected). Items with no rival listing no longer wait 4 s and report no data when Marketbuddy opens the search. Today's lost sales match our own sales more reliably. 0.3.14.1 — Fix: items right after a duplicate row could report no market data when Marketbuddy opens Compare prices automatically; the search it opened is now used. 0.3.14.0 — Stock tracking: select several items and restock them in one run (Select low, Restock selected). Auto-restock now also works during AutoRetainer visits, one retainer at a time. [Match price] chat link and Reprice tab button for prices blocked by Max drop or Max raise: one-shot, tied to the price you reviewed. Market searches no longer collide with the previous item's results: they wait, retry on "Please wait and try your search again.", and finish sooner when no rival is listed. Market sale history that arrives late is kept.
Punchline: Restocker fork: bulk reprice with price guards, sales tracking and an optional bell auto-cycle.
Description: Personal fork of yagi2/Restocker. Reprice every retainer listing to the live market lowest -N gil with floor / max-drop guards, track each listing until it sells (reprices, competitors, days, gil), one-click full cycle and an optional timed auto-cycle at the summoning bell that waits for AutoRetainer. Timed automation is against the FFXIV ToS; use at your own risk.
